snippet.title: Wild n' Chill - Escape The Nonsense Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

From Wombat Brawler, the makers of Cast n Chill, comes a cozy wilderness survival game you can play with friends. Hunt, fish, trap, gather, and build anything from a leaky lean-to to a proper cabin, while keeping an eye out for bears and wolves. It has 11 areas to explore and supports up to four players.
